WITH status_avgs AS (
  SELECT
    CENTROMEA AS status,
    AVG(HGB) AS avg_hgb,
    AVG(`T-BIL` / NULLIF(CRE, 0)) AS avg_ratio
  FROM Laboratory
  WHERE Date > '1985-04-22'
    AND Date < '1994-03-14'
  GROUP BY CENTROMEA
),
with_overall AS (
  SELECT
    status,
    avg_hgb,
    avg_ratio,
    AVG(avg_ratio) OVER () AS overall_mean_ratio
  FROM status_avgs
)
SELECT
  status,
  avg_hgb,
  avg_ratio,
  avg_ratio / NULLIF(overall_mean_ratio, 0) AS ratio_divided_by_overall_mean
FROM with_overall
WHERE overall_mean_ratio IS NOT NULL;

assumptions.assumption: A test with CRE equal to zero has an undefined ratio and is excluded from the ratio average; NULL values are likewise ignored. Status groups include NULL CENTROMEA values as one group.
